verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's own marketing says it lets merchants offer products in local currency and accept payments from 135+ countries as merchant of record, which covers the core of charging in local currencies. Nothing documents settling payouts to the founder's bank in their own currency, or how FX conversion rates and spreads are handled. A community report notes that extra international and payout fees are listed in the fees docs but not on the pricing page, which weakens the transparency claim. missing for 10: documented payout/settlement currency to the seller's bank, FX conversion rate and spread disclosure, a list of supported currencies, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-currency checkout.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**.
As your merchant of record, you can **accept payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.
